reasoning: As of March 6, 2026, we need to assess whether the FDA has authorized an LLM-based medical device by March 31, 2026 (25 days remaining). The background indicates no LLM-based devices have been approved yet, despite 950+ AI/ML devices being authorized. Key barriers include regulatory uncertainty around LLM's broad capabilities versus specific indications for use, and lack of established frameworks for continuous software updates. However, at least one company (Contrast Llama) has sought FDA feedback. The 25-day window is very short for FDA authorization, which typically takes months to years. While regulatory frameworks are being developed (PCCPs), actual approvals remain pending. The probability of authorization occurring in this narrow timeframe is low, though not impossible if a submission was already in advanced stages.
